_why: SPEC-207. The crawl on/off state used to live only in Supabase edge secrets — invisible in git, unreviewable, and unanswerable from the sandbox. Whether we were crawling was a question nobody could answer without opening a dashboard. It lives here now: committed, diffable, and reversible with one PR. CI pushes these into the edge-function runtime on every change.
_founder: 2026-08-03: 'add all sources not just creators to the crawl at 100 leads each max to review (except yelp)'. Supersedes 2026-08-02 'activate the crawls just for the creator sources to get 100 of each then pause alongside the rest to audit' — the creator-only phase is over; the audit-then-clear shape stays.
_CRAWLS_SUSPENDED: Global stop. false = the allowlist below decides. Defaults to SUSPENDED in code, so a typo here fails closed.
_CRAWLS_ONLY: ONLY these sources may run. SPEC-270 (founder, 2026-08-07, verbatim: 'scale creators and IG services to 250 contactable (whatever the # total nubmer is..) .. for creators and IG services only for now... keep the other cralwers parked... conserve tokens ... but deliver gradually to download'): the allowlist narrows to the TWO creator sources — ig_services (dual-class, paid Apify IG under the standing founder override) and se:web-harvest (free relay harvest). The parked services sources (osm, craigslist, yellowpages_apify, google_lsa, gmaps_apify) are PARKED not deleted: they stay in the rota, dashboards and code, their rows are kept, they simply stay out of this list until the founder re-opens them — the yelp shape (SPEC-239). SUPERSEDED-IN-VALUE: SPEC-243 (founder, 2026-08-03, verbatim: 'add all sources not just creators to the crawl at 100 leads each max to review (except yelp)') — the FULL rota minus yelp. Every source here is governed by a stop: the two creator sources (ig_services via ig-scraper-user-search, se:web-harvest via creator-harvest — SPEC-230: exactly TWO, both listed or the last path to a founder target silently closes) self-stop at CREATOR_TARGET, and every services source self-stops at SOURCE_AUDIT_CAP leads (below). se:web-harvest is not in the crawl rota (cron-driven, SPEC-237), but creator-harvest reads this allowlist and refuses to run when its name is absent. ig-creator-marketplace stays REMOVED (SPEC-221). yelp is PAUSED as a source, not deleted (founder, 2026-08-02: 'don't delete yelp.. just pause as a source') — it stays in the code and the dashboards, its rows are kept, and it stays out of this allowlist until the founder re-activates it (gate #239).
_CREATOR_TARGET: EACH creator source stops ITSELF at this count — SPEC-270 (founder, 2026-08-07, verbatim: 'scale creators and IG services to 250 contactable (whatever the # total nubmer is..)'): the target is 250 CONTACTABLE rows per source — the count adds or(email.not.is.null,phone.not.is.null) [owner_email for the services table has its own bar] so uncontactable rows do NOT satisfy the stop and the total row count floats to whatever nets 250 contactable, which is exactly the founder's parenthetical. Prior order (2026-08-02: 'get 100 of each then pause alongside the rest to audit') is superseded in VALUE and COUNT SEMANTICS; the stop-yourself mechanism is unchanged. ig_services counts NEW-SPEC rows ONLY — SPEC-259 (founder, 2026-08-05, verbatim: 'share 100 new resuls from the creator new spec run... to complete the evaluation....'): eq(discovered_via, ig-scraper-user-search) AND in(category, CREATOR_CATEGORIES slugs), because since SPEC-257 only creator-category-search rows carry a category slug while the OLD deviation rows carry services-rota terms ('junk removal'); the old rows are KEPT in the table but NOT counted, or the crawl would stop short of the 100 new-spec rows the founder is evaluating. creator-harvest counts by PREFIX like(discovered_via, se:web-harvest%) because its tag is stamped per run day (SPEC-237) — unchanged by SPEC-259. Checked before any job is claimed / any search is fired, so neither can overshoot while nobody is watching.
_CREATOR_PIPELINE: SPEC-257 (founder, 2026-08-05, verbatim: "the services IG creators has 'junk removal' .. which wasn't part of the spec... the creators web crawling spec should have included multi step... (search top 25 micro to mid influencers (per each of the indicated cateogries), crawl names and emails and IG handles (visible from site ..) 3-get tel and email from website and or IG or other..."). The three steps as built: (1) SEARCH — the ig_services creator half searches CREATOR_CATEGORIES (specs/CERGIO-CRAWL-LISTS.md creator Tiers 1+2, founder order; Tier 3 follows the same shape when the founder clears it), top 25 creator rows per category (CREATOR_CAT_CAP) before moving to the next category in tier order — never the services rota, which is how 'junk removal' creators happened. (2) CRAWL — names, emails and IG handles taken from the account's own public profile/bio at ingest. (3) ENRICH — tel + email from the creator's own website / link-in-bio / other public pages via the existing creator-enrich function (unchanged by SPEC-257). Micro-to-mid follower banding is applied where the source exposes follower counts (IG profile fetch / creator-enrich): approximate band 10,000–500,000 followers. Rows outside the band are KEPT, never dropped — the stored followers value IS the mark and the audit filters on it. Data is data.
_PHASE1_CITY_QUOTA: SET BY THE FOUNDER — a FORMULA, not a number (2026-08-02, verbatim: '50k services for nyc (with 5% of that as creators).. adjusting each city based on relative size of dma (eg: if miami is 10% of new it should be 5k services and 250 creators..'). services(city) = 50,000 × DMA(city)/DMA(NYC), DMA size in Nielsen TV households (2024-25 LTMUE), rounded to the nearest 100; creators = 5% of that (informational here — CREATOR_TARGET=100 is the standing get-100-then-audit order and governs creators until the founder lifts it). SPEC-244 (founder, 2026-08-03: 'THE DMA is technically held by it's own DMA definition (that's unrelated to state)... use a standard DMA definition / boundary'): keys are Nielsen DMA codes, never state abbreviations — 501 = New York (7,494,510 households → 50,000), 528 = Miami-Ft. Lauderdale (1,756,920, 23.4% → 11,700). A state is not a DMA: Florida holds multiple DMAs (Miami-Ft. Lauderdale, Orlando, Tampa) and the New York DMA reaches into NJ (Jersey City, Newark) and CT. Phase 2 quotas are PRE-COMPUTED in the build spec (LA 38,900 · Chicago 24,400 · Dallas 21,800 · Philadelphia 21,000 · Houston 18,700 · Atlanta 18,400 · DC 17,600 · Boston 17,200 · Phoenix 14,700; 9th metro = Boston, founder 2026-08-02) but stay OUT of this map until Phase 1 is full — a DMA absent from the map cannot be crawled past phase gating. Both consumers (fulfill-crawl, _growth-scope.mjs) parse this map FAIL-CLOSED: empty, unparseable, or non-positive values mean Phase 2 stays locked. Refresh the numbers when Nielsen publishes new estimates.
_SOURCE_AUDIT_CAP: SPEC-243 (founder, 2026-08-03, verbatim: 'add all sources not just creators to the crawl at 100 leads each max to review (except yelp)'), CORRECTED by SPEC-246 (founder, 2026-08-03, verbatim: 'No I need 100 FRESH peices of DATA from each to VERIFY they're solid to scale'). EACH services source stops ITSELF at this many FRESH leads_services rows — fetched_at >= AUDIT_FRESH_SINCE below — counted per source BEFORE any job is claimed in fulfill-crawl, the same shape as CREATOR_TARGET. Historical rows do NOT count: a source with 2,000 old rows still owes 100 new ones, because the audit verifies the source is solid TO SCALE NOW, not that it once worked. The count uses every data_source value a source's rows actually carry (AUDIT_CAP_SOURCES in _shared/opsPayload.ts — yellowpages_apify writes 'yellowpages', google_lsa's history includes folded 'google_sponsored' rows). Unreadable count = that source refuses to run (fail closed). When every source has its 100 fresh, everything is paused and the founder audits the exports, then names cleared sources. Spend rules unchanged: the $1 tranche ladder and $0.05/lead cap still gate every paid source underneath this.
_AUDIT_FRESH_SINCE: SPEC-246 — the FRESHNESS line for the audit cap: only leads fetched at or after this instant count toward SOURCE_AUDIT_CAP. Set to the day of the founder's order (2026-08-03, 'No I need 100 FRESH peices of DATA from each to VERIFY they're solid to scale'). Moving this forward re-opens every source for a new 100 — that is a founder decision, made by editing this committed value, never by code drift. Unparseable = fail CLOSED in both consumers: the cap falls back to counting ALL rows (which can only pause sources sooner, never spend more).
_SPEND_INCREMENT_USD: SPEC-253 (founder, 2026-08-03, verbatim: 'been charging Apify WITHOUT any delivery... MUST institute a strict pay per delivery with 0.5 increments to stop and verify we're getting leads (contactable)... we've already wasted over $100... this cannot continue... especially once we press GO on SCALE, we can quickly run up thousands with ZERO OUTPUT... just increased the plan by another $10 to test.. but can't spin wheels or spend on no delivery'). Every paid source spends in $0.50 steps measured from SPEND_CHECKPOINT_AT; a source that has spent its current step STOPS until that spend produced contactable leads at or under the $0.05/lead ceiling (fresh since the checkpoint, counted through the multi-name map so no label mismatch starves a producer); delivery unlocks the next $0.50; no delivery = blocked at no more than $0.50 of new money. Worst case across all six Apify sources = $3 with zero output — the thousands-with-zero-output scale run cannot happen.
_SPEND_CHECKPOINT_AT: SPEC-253 — the line pay-per-delivery measures from. The >$100 historical waste stays on the ledger and in the spend report but no longer decides the next $0.50: the founder funded a fresh $10 test ('just increased the plan by another $10 to test'), so spend and delivery are both counted from this instant. Moving this is a founder decision, made by editing this committed value — never by code drift. Unparseable = fail CLOSED: spend is counted from ALL history, which can only block sooner, never spend more. MOVED 2026-08-04 (SPEC-255): the founder ordered both replacement actors RUN ('let's find an alternative for yellowpages... and also one for craigslist that's cheaper... run the rest in the meantime... so i see 100 pieces of data per source'), and the DEAD actors' spend since the old 2026-08-03T20:30Z line — $0.66 yellowpages (trudax: HTTP 403 monthly-limit then 400, 0 leads) and $2.09 craigslist (memo23: $0.104/fresh-lead, 2x the $0.05 ceiling) — must not eat the replacements' (solidcode, pay-per-result) first $0.50. That dead spend stays on the ledger and the report; it just no longer decides the next step. Gate #253 still holds: the value parses and is after 2026-08-03.
_APIFY_MONTH_BASELINE_USD: SPEC-256 (founder, 2026-08-05, verbatim: 'added another $10... apify has now burnt through 195 with marginable delivery ... (including $~15 since we last implemented the tight hard deliver against spend controls...)... there's leakage that drains budget once we scale... need this tightly locked.. there cannot be spending without delivery'). The account's month-to-date meter as the founder read it off the Apify console when ordering the lock (2026-08-05, '$195'). New spend is measured as (vendor month total − this baseline), so the historical $195 stays on the ledger and the report but does not consume the ceiling below. Reset to the console reading whenever the founder funds a new tranche — a founder decision, made by editing this committed value, never by code drift.
_APIFY_MONTH_CEILING_USD: SPEC-256 — the WHOLE Apify account may spend at most this much NEW money this month ('added another $10'), enforced in the worker BEFORE any paid claim: when (month total − baseline) ≥ ceiling, every Apify-vendor source refuses to run, regardless of per-source state. This is the backstop above the per-source SPEC-253 steps — if per-source math is ever wrong (shared actors, label drift, a broken meter), the account total still cannot grow past the money the founder actually put in. Fail CLOSED: either value unparseable → ceiling treated as 0 → all paid crawling stops (loud in the board notes, cheap by construction).
_CONTACT_BAR_PCT: A source under 40% contactable is PARKED, not retried (founder, 2026-08-02).
